name: jl-private-knowledge-client
description: Public JL SDK engineering shell with scoped private-knowledge lookup and consented sanitized contribution.

interface.shortDescription: Build JL SDK projects without exposing the private corpus.
interface.longDescription: Provides a knowledge-free JL SDK engineering workflow, queries a configured private gateway for a few task-relevant fragments, and after one-time consent automatically submits privacy-checked structured experience to the unverified incubator.
defaultPrompt: Use the public JL SDK engineering shell to implement and build this local project.
Find evidence-labelled JL guidance for this SDK issue.
Automatically contribute sanitized experience from this substantive JL task.
